# Teacher code context

Student is the only service allowed to join a student, learning action, private
answer, and Sandbox workspace. The internal code-context route first proves the
exact `(student_id, learning_action_id)` ownership pair and requires the action
to remain open. It then resolves Sandbox by the action's private answer ID; the
answer and Sandbox identifiers are never returned.

The `student-learning-action-code-context-v1` projection contains only UTF-8
text. It excludes known secret paths and secret-assignment lines, dependencies,
build output, lock files, binary/media/font/archive files, traversal paths, and
duplicate paths. The response is deterministic and bounded to 12 sorted files,
16 KiB per file, and 64 KiB total, with explicit file/global truncation data.

For the exact same Sandbox, Student also joins the latest
`sandbox-validation-observation-v1`: whether an observation exists, whether it
came from validation or tests, pass/fail, a bounded issue count, and its time.
Sandbox invalidates this record on every workspace mutation before optional
revalidation. Messages, expected/actual output, private tests, validator names,
and raw diagnostics never cross this boundary.

A missing workspace is a valid `available:false` projection because some
learning actions do not need a Sandbox. A failing Sandbox dependency is not
silently downgraded to an empty snapshot. Raw live/final validator output,
objective result, evidence, and mastery are outside this contract.
